article.title: Hong Kong fact of the day
article.excerpt: Hong Kong just set another property-price record. This time, it was for a parking space. A 188-square-foot space on Hong Kong island sold for HK$5.18 million ($664,300), or HK$27,500 a square foot, last month, newspaper Ming Pao reported Wednesday, citing land registration records. article.title: Where to eat in Hong Kong
article.excerpt: Anywhere near downtown virtually all of the good places are quite expensive. The good news is that there are many of them and they are quite fine indeed. Two I can recommend are Mott 32 and Ye Shanghai , near Central and Admiralty respectively. My favorite meal of the trip was out at Sha Tin 18 , in the New Territories Hyatt.
